title: Choose what comes off your desk.
intro: From a crowded calendar to documents waiting for review, the right support starts with a clearly defined responsibility. Explore the work below and build a role around the tasks that interrupt your day most often.
caption: Practical support, shaped around your working week.
groups: Bring a typical week, meeting priorities and the messages that need your attention. Set rules for scheduling and sorting before asking an assistant to act on your behalf.
Identify the projects, vendors and internal owners that need regular follow-up. Agree how progress is recorded and when a late response needs your intervention.
Share examples of an acceptable brief, document or update. A consistent format lets you review the decisions that matter without reconstructing the work.
